Sybil resistance: quadratic-priced dispute votes bound to a beacon horizon.
Mechanism: each vote against a flagged answer costs v^2 points (1st=1, 5th=25), so bulk voting collapses quadratically.
Operation: a grader posts a hash plus 0.50-unit escrow; votes stay sealed until epoch+12, then correct voters take 0.25 from losers. New identities wait 10 epochs in a harbor queue at 0.1 weight; fees fund a karst pool of re-checkers.
Attacker cost: 50 sockpuppets lock 0.50 each to out-vote one grader; on collusion reveal, 25 units burn, risking 50 per seat.
